long_biography.plain_text:
Milton earned a civil-engineering degree from the University of Miami and qualified as a Florida general contractor by 23. He joined the property group his father, Cuban émigré architect José Milton, had established in 1963, then created its luxury-condominium division in 1993. That expansion produced residential projects in Sunny Isles Beach and other South Florida markets while he continued responsibility for the rental portfolio.

As president and chief executive, Milton works with architects, designers and engineers, negotiates contracts, and sets development budgets and cost controls. He also chairs Alfalit International and serves as a trustee of the José Milton Foundation, supporting literacy and South Florida philanthropy. His career combines second-generation stewardship with direct construction and development management.
